base_record_snapshot.lesson: A claim inherited from handoff/prior-tic narrative is a HYPOTHESIS, not blocker state — before any gate/blocker/absence claim shapes a session's plan, it must be re-verified against the live field (the specific registry, the live board slice, the actual presence evidence), and the verification is CASE-2 SHAPED: the governing laws usually already exist and may even recite at boot (absence-from-an-index is not absence-from-the-field; RE-TEST capability walls; probe residency, don't inherit it) — the gap is rehydration AT THE LOCUS where the claim enters (the tool's default-parameter scope, the handoff's residency line, the 'if room' hedge). Three teeth: (1) a DEFAULT parameter's scope silently becomes the claim's scope — a selection that read only the default manifest may only claim manifest-absence, never field-absence; (2) residency/presence of the human is a probeable fact (session-opening approval, same-day capture artifacts), never a narrative carry; (3) an undefined scheduling hedge ('if room') is a blocker-claim in disguise — replace with a tranche position or a named gate. Wrong claims already acted on get append-only record corrections, never retcons.
